nudges.text: Find the oldest thing within arm's reach. Imagine the first person who touched it.
Go outside. Turn left. Walk for exactly 3 minutes. Then come back.
Touch the coldest surface you can find. Then the warmest.
Stand at a window. Describe what you see out loud, as if to someone who can't see it.
Find something you own that shows wear. Hold it for a minute.
Open a drawer or cabinet you rarely open. Look at what's inside for 30 seconds. Close it.
Listen. Identify 5 distinct sounds. Say each one out loud as you hear it.
Walk to the furthest corner of wherever you are. Stand there for 60 seconds.
Pick up the nearest book. Open to page 50. Read the first full sentence out loud.
Find something blue. Then find something that's almost the same blue, but not quite.
Go outside. Watch the first moving thing you see until it's gone.
Look at your ceiling for 60 seconds. Count every mark, shadow, or detail you can see.
Find the ugliest thing in the room. Look at it for 30 seconds without looking away.
Find a mirror. Make eye contact with yourself for 30 seconds.
Find the object you've owned the longest. Hold it. Try to remember where you were when you got it.
Count the steps from where you're sitting to the nearest door. Then count them again, slower.
Find something red. Put it somewhere it doesn't belong. Leave it there for an hour.
Sit on the floor for 2 minutes. Notice how the room looks different from down there.
Pick a wall. Walk along it, touching it, until you're back where you started.
Find the smallest thing you can see from where you're sitting. Look at it for 30 seconds.
Hum a song you haven't heard in years. See how much of it you remember.
Go to your front door. Open it. Stand in the doorway for 60 seconds. Close it.
Find two objects that have never touched each other. Make them touch.
Pick one thing you can see through a window. Watch only that thing for 2 minutes.
Smell something nearby. Describe the smell out loud using exactly 3 words.
